summary: Iteration 7 — Frontend-only QA of per-category search bars across every list page and role. All 27 requested checks pass. No blocking bugs, no console TypeErrors, no crashes. Test ad-spend entry created and cleaned up. Thresholds untouched.
critical_code_review_comments: Bits.jsx SearchBar is small, focused, reused across ~11 places — good DRY win. searchMatch treats null/undefined safely with String(v ?? '') — no crash-on-null risk. onChange fires on every keystroke so all list pages re-filter client-side; fine at current row counts (Team=3, reviews=2, spend<10). If a page ever renders 5k+ rows (e.g. large paginated Airtable list) consider debouncing (100–150ms) or useDeferredValue to keep typing responsive.

JobsBoard.jsx uses testid 'review-log-row' for its reviews table (different from /marketing which uses 'review-row' + 'reviews-table'). The review request mentioned the /jobs 'reviews table' — that table renders correctly but has no data-testid on the <table> itself, so automated testers can't quickly assert 'reviews table present on /jobs'. Minor: consider adding data-testid='jobs-reviews-table' on the <table> element for consistency with MarketingDashboard's data-testid='reviews-table'.

role-switch-select is a shadcn radix Select (rendered as <button>), not a native <select>. Its data-testid is on the trigger button. Playwright can find the option via get_by_role('option', name='Marketing view') after opening — but automated tests can't use page.select_option on it. Documenting for future testing agents.

Login form React state does NOT accept Playwright's page.fill() cleanly — the Sign-In button stays disabled unless keystrokes are typed. Future testing agents should use page.keyboard.type() with delay >= 15ms after clicking each input. Not a user-facing bug (real humans type), but worth noting to prevent flaky tests.

seed_data_creation: Created one ad-spend entry ('Search QA Camp', $100, Meta platform, range 06/20/2026–07/19/2026) then DELETED at end of the test via adspend-delete-btn. Verified DB clean (0 spend entries after delete). No other seed changes. No review_request docs were mutated in iteration 7 (only searched). Thresholds untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SearchBar (Bits.jsx) + searchMatch is the shared filter primitive. Every list page passes {value, onChange, testId, placeholder}. Verified data-flow works end-to-end on the two pages with real data (Team, Marketing) and renders on all Airtable-empty pages (Leads/Contacts/Projects/Tasks/Blog/Invoices/Subscriptions). Airtable is still not configured in preview — that's expected. Square is LIVE — did NOT touch invoices. For future work: the /jobs review-log-row table has no data-testid on the <table>, and role-switch-select is a shadcn button not a native select — tests should open then click get_by_role('option').
